newsitem.title: GERMANY: CDU's Hintze says German jobs turnaround possible.
newsitem.headline: CDU's Hintze says German jobs turnaround possible.

text.p: The April fall in unadjusted German unemployment shows that government policies are working and a turnaround on the jobs market can be achieved, Chancellor Helmut Kohl's Christian Democrats (CDU) said on Tuesday.
"We can achieve a turnaround on the jobs market. The new jobs figures show that," CDU general secretary Peter Hintze said in a statement.

"The programme for more growth and employment is showing results. The labour market will get a further boost from the comprehensive tax reform," Hintze added, appealing to the opposition Social Democrats to support the tax reform.

Hintze was reacting to unadjusted April unemployment data -- the most politically sensitive figure in Germany -- which showed the number of people out of work fell to 4.347 million from 4.477 million in March.
On an adjusted basis, which gives a more accurate picture of the labour market, unemployment rose slightly to a seasonally adjusted 4.299 million in April.
